column1: # Rows per class from that class's latest round (2026-11-04: warrior and paladin round 4, bear and Warden round 4 from tank-fixes4), each rebenched on its own branch: 1000 iterations, default seed. tankbench -iters 1000 -encounter tools/encounters/<boss>.json tools/tankbench/req/<request>.json

# weight = the request name's preset (Max threat 1/3, Balanced 1, Max survival 3); score = tankbench's column at that weight, raid DPS; * = legacy request, Balanced assumed. scoring_mean = mean of the 6 bosses without ragnaros; "none" = no healing saves it.
